newsitem.title: USA: "Law & Order" producer knocks McCain on TV ratings.
newsitem.headline: "Law & Order" producer knocks McCain on TV ratings.

text.p: TV producer Dick Wolf Friday lashed out at U.S. Senator John McCain, Republican of Arizona for choosing the wrong target in his efforts at reducing violence in American.

Wolf, who producers "Law & Order," and "New York Undercover," said that if McCain was really worried about protecting children from violence he should not have opposed two measures that would have controlled handguns in the U.S.

Wolf spoke to reporters here during the semi-annual press tour put on by the TV networks for Journalist. Wolf is executive producer of a new dramatic series, "Players", that would appear on General Electric Co's NBC in the fall on Fridays at 2000/ET.

McCain, in a telephone interview said "there is no connection" between the new ratings system and his opposition to the handgun legislation. McCain said Wolf's comments were intended to improve the ratings for his shows and that Wolf was afraid to give parents a chance to screen-out potentially objectionable programs.
